scope: The Wistaria Tea House in Taipei in July 2014, including the two-story street-side range, attached lower range, Japanese timber wings, courtyard walls and entrance gate.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The city describes the one-story Japanese house and the 1960 two-story reconstruction after typhoon damage.
The operator describes the historic residence and identifies the three wisteria vines planted in the courtyard.
